Rashi on Makkot 5a:11:1.hebrew: לנהורא בריא - שמא מאור עיניהם של אלו בריא, וצופין למרחוק יותר ממנו:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:11:1.english: Good eyesight - Perhaps the eyes' light of these [witnesses] is healthy, and they see at a greater distance than he [an ordinary person] can.

Rashi on Makkot 5a:13:1.hebrew: גמלא פרחא - מין גמלים יש שהם קלים במרוצתם כעוף הפורח:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:13:1.english: A flying camel - There is a kind of camel that is swift in its running, like a flying bird.

Rashi on Makkot 5a:14:1.hebrew: ולא עוד אלא אפי' אמרו - עדים המזימין את הראשונים: ״בערב שבת הרגו״, הראשונים נהרגים, שהקדימו חובתו יותר מן הראשונים:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:14:1.english: And not only that, but even if they said - The conspiring witnesses [said that the murderer killed] on Shabbat eve, [the first witnesses are executed], because [the conspirators] advanced his liability [to an earlier date] than the first [witnesses] did.

Rashi on Makkot 5a:14:2.hebrew: מאי טעמא דבעידנא דקא מסהדי - כשבאו יום שלישי בשבת להעיד עליו, אכתי גברא לאו בר קטלא, שלא הועד עליו בבית דין. ואילו הוה אתי ומודה, הוה מיפטר. נמצא שהם היו מחייבין מיתה את מי שאינו ראוי למות:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:14:2.english: What is the reason? Because at the time that they testify - When they came on Tuesday to testify against him, the man was still not liable to be executed, since no testimony had been given against him in the court. And if he had come and confessed, he would have been exempt. It turns out that they were making liable to death one who was not fit to die.

Rashi on Makkot 5a:15:1.hebrew: מאי קמ"ל - דאע"ג דאיהו מיקטיל, אינהו מיקטלי. והקשה: תנינא במתני' בפרקין (דף ו:) גבי שנים רואין אותם מחלון זה כו', הוא והן נהרגים:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:15:1.english: What does he teach us? - That even though he (the accused) is executed, they (the witnesses) are [also] executed. [The Gemara asks:] We already learned this in the Mishnah in our chapter (6b), regarding the case of two [witnesses] who see them from this window, etc.: "he and they are executed."

Rashi on Makkot 5a:16:1.hebrew: מה שאין כן - שייך בהזמת עדי גמר דין:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:16:1.english: That it is not so - [this applies] with regard to the refutation of witnesses [who testified about] the verdict.

Rashi on Makkot 5a:16:2.hebrew: ולא עוד כו' - שאע"פ שאלו האחרונים מאחרים את זמן גמר דינו, מ"מ מודים הן שביום שבאו הזוממין להעיד עליו, בשלישי בשבת, כבר היה דינו נגמר מאתמול, ובגברא קטילא אסהוד:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:16:2.english: And moreover, etc. - For even though these latter [witnesses] push off the time of the completion of his verdict to a later time, nevertheless they concede that on the day that the conspiring witnesses came to testify against him, on Tuesday, his verdict had already been completed from the day before, and [the first witnesses] testified about a man who was already liable to death.

Rashi on Makkot 5a:17:1.hebrew: וכן לענין תשלומי קנס - שהמודה בו פטור, דינו נמי בזה כדיני נפשות, ויש חילוק בין עדות גוף המעשה לעדות של גמר דין:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:17:1.english: And likewise with regard to payments of a fine - [A fine] in which one who admits to it is exempt [from paying]; its law in this matter is also like [that of] capital cases, and there is a distinction between testimony about the act itself and testimony about the final verdict.

Rashi on Makkot 5a:18:1.hebrew: הכי גרסינן: באו שנים ואמרו בחד בשבתא גנב וטבח ומכר, ובאו שנים ואמרו בחד בשבתא עמנו הייתם, אלא בתרי בשבתא גנב וטבח ומכר, ולא עוד אלא אפי' אמרו בערב שבת גנב וטבח ומכר, משלמין, דבעידנא דקא מסהדי גברא לאו בר תשלומין הוא - ופירושו, משום דהוה מצי למיפטר נפשיה בהודאה, אישתכח דאינהו הוו מפסדי ליה. ודוקא קנס, אבל בעדות ממון פטורין, שהרי לא היו מפסידין אותו כלום אחר שהוא מחויב ועומד:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:18:1.english: If two came and said: On Sunday he stole, slaughtered, and sold; and two came and said: On Sunday you were with us, but on Monday he stole, slaughtered, and sold; and not only that, but even if they said: On Friday he stole, slaughtered, and sold, they pay, for at the time they testify the man is not yet liable to pay - This is how we read it. Its explanation is: because he could have exempted himself by confession, it turns out that they are the ones causing him a loss. And this applies only to a fine; but in testimony about monetary liability they are exempt, since they would cause him no loss at all, as he is already obligated and standing [in liability].

Rashi on Makkot 5a:19:1.hebrew: גברא בר תשלומין הוא - כשהעידו אלו עליו, כבר חייבוהו בית דין, ואי הוה מודי לא הוה מיפטר:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:19:1.english: The man is liable for payment - When these [witnesses] testified about him, the court had already declared him liable, and had he admitted [the act], he would not have been exempted.

Rashi on Makkot 5a:1:1.hebrew: להכרזה - דאמרינן בסנהדרין באלו הן הנחנקין (סנהדרין דף פט.): ארבעה צריכין הכרזה. לאחר שנענשו בב"ד, צריכין ב"ד להכריז: כך וכך נהרג פלוני בב"ד על עבירה פלונית, כדי לרדות את השומעין:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:1:1.english: For proclamation - As we say in Tractate Sanhedrin, in the chapter "These Are Those Who Are Strangled" (Sanhedrin 89a): Four [offenders] require proclamation. After they have been sentenced in court, the court must proclaim: "So-and-so was executed by the court for such-and-such a transgression," in order to deter those who hear.

Rashi on Makkot 5a:1:2.hebrew: מ״וישמעו ויראו״ נפקא - ואזהרה מ״לא יוסיפו״:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:1:2.english: It is derived from “and shall hear and fear” - And the prohibition is derived from “they shall not continue [to do any more evil]”.

Rashi on Makkot 5a:2:1.english: One divides in monetary [cases] - As [the Mishnah] goes on to explain.

Rashi on Makkot 5a:3:1.hebrew: מנהני מילי - דכל אחד סופג את הארבעים:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:3:1.english: From where [are] these matters - That each one absorbs the forty [lashes].

Rashi on Makkot 5a:3:2.hebrew: רשע בחייבי מיתות - אשר הוא רשע, מחוייב למות:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:3:2.english: “Wicked” with regard to those liable to death penalties - Who is wicked, liable to die.

Rashi on Makkot 5a:3:3.hebrew: בחייבי מלקות - נאמר "רשע", אם בן הכות הרשע:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:3:3.english: With regard to those liable to lashes - "Wicked" is stated, as it says, "If the wicked one is liable to be beaten" (Deuteronomy 25:2).

Rashi on Makkot 5a:4:1.hebrew: כאשר זמם - שיקבל הנדון מלקות שלימה:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:4:1.english: As he conspired - That the one condemned [by the false testimony] should receive a complete [set of] lashes.

Rashi on Makkot 5a:4:2.hebrew: ממון מצטרף - והרי קיבל מה שרצו להפסידו בין כולם:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:4:2.english: Money combines - For [the defendant] has received, among all of them [together], what they wished to cause him to lose.

Rashi on Makkot 5a:5:1.hebrew: שיזימו את עצמן - שיזימו אותן בעסקי גופן, ולא בעסקי ההורג וההרוג, כדמפרש ואזיל:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:5:1.english: Until they impeach themselves - Until [the second witnesses] impeach them regarding matters concerning their own persons, and not regarding matters concerning the killer and the victim, as [the Gemara] explains as it proceeds.

Rashi on Makkot 5a:7:1.hebrew: באו אחרים - שהעידו עליו כעדות הראשונים:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:7:1.english: Others came - who testified against him with the same testimony as the first [witnesses].

Rashi on Makkot 5a:7:2.hebrew: והזימו - אלו השנים שהזימו את הראשונים, הזימו גם את האחרונים:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:7:2.english: And they rendered [them] conspiring - These two [witnesses] who rendered the first [witnesses] conspiring also rendered the latter ones conspiring.

Rashi on Makkot 5a:7:3.hebrew: אפילו - אם הן מאה כתות זו אחר זו, וכת אחת הזימתן כולן — יהרגו:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:7:3.english: Even - if there are a hundred sets [of witnesses], one after another, and one [single] set rendered all of them conspiring witnesses, all of them are executed.

Rashi on Makkot 5a:7:4.hebrew: איסטטית היא זו - הכת הזאת כת של עדות סרה וסטיא היא. כך נטלו עצה ביניהם להזים את כל עֵד הבא להעיד עליו:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:7:4.english: This is an istatit - This group is a group of deviant and astray testimony. [That is,] they took counsel among themselves to render conspiring every [witness] who comes to testify against him.

Rashi on Makkot 5a:8:1.hebrew: גופה של עדות - גופן של עדים:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:8:1.english: The body of the testimony - the body of the witnesses themselves.

Rashi on Makkot 5a:9:1.hebrew: לענות בו סרה - בפרשת עדים זוממין כתיב "סרה". היינו עדות המוסרת, שהוסרו משם:
Rashi on Makkot 5a:9:1.english: To bear perverted witness against him - In the passage of conspiring witnesses, "perverted" (sarah) is written. [That is,] testimony that is removed, [meaning] that [the witnesses] were removed from there.

Tosafot on Makkot 5a:16:1.hebrew: דבעידנא דאסהידו עדים לאו בר קטלא הוא - פ"ה: משום דאי הוה מודה מיפטר. ולא נראה, דזה לא מצינו; דאם כן, כל חייבי מיתות בית דין יכול להודות ולפטור עצמו. ונראה לפרש: לאו בר קטלא הוא — פירוש, קודם שנגמר דינו הוא, דשמא לא יבואו עדים, ואם יבואו עדים לא יהא עדותן קיים. ועוד, שאסור להורגו עד שיגמר דינו; וכשנגמר דינו, כבר ודאי בר חיובא הוא, הואיל וכבר באו עדים ונתקבל עדותן, וההורגו פטור:
Tosafot on Makkot 5a:16:1.english: "For at the time that the witnesses testified, he was not liable to be executed" - Rashi explains: because if he had confessed, he would be exempt. But this does not seem right, for we do not find this [principle]; for if so, anyone liable to death at the hands of a court could confess and exempt himself. Rather, it seems to explain "he was not liable to be executed" as meaning: before his verdict was completed, [he was not yet liable], for perhaps witnesses will not come, and if witnesses do come, their testimony may not be valid. Furthermore, it is forbidden to execute him until his verdict is completed; and once his verdict has been completed, he is certainly liable [to death], since witnesses have already come and their testimony was accepted, and one who kills him is exempt.

Tosafot on Makkot 5a:17:1.hebrew: וכן לענין קנס - אבל ודאי לענין ממון לא: דכשמעידין דבחד בשבת גנב, ובאו שנים ואמרו דבערב שבת גנב ובחד בשבת עמנו הייתם, ודאי אין משלמין ממון, דבההיא שעתא דמסהדי גנבא בר חיובא, אע"ג דלגבי נפשות לא תדמנו לבר חיובא. דכל כמה דלא נגמר דינו (נמי הוי בר חיובא משום שאינו ספק כל כך עדות) בממון [הוי] קרוב לודאי שיבואו עדים ויעידו; אבל בעדות נפשות דבעינן דרישה וחקירה, אז ודאי אמרינן דקודם שנגמר דינו לאו הוי בר חיובא:
Tosafot on Makkot 5a:17:1.english: "And likewise, with regard to a fine" - But certainly with regard to monetary matters, no (the same does not apply): For when [witnesses] testify that he stole on Sunday, and two others came and said, "On Friday he stole, and on Sunday you were with us," they certainly do not pay money, because at that moment when [the first witnesses] testify, the thief is liable, even though with regard to capital cases "you shall not regard him as one who is liable." For as long as his verdict has not been finalized (he is also considered liable, because the testimony is not so doubtful) in monetary matters, it is close to certain that witnesses will come and testify; but in capital testimony, where we require examination and cross-examination, there we certainly say that before his verdict is finalized he is not considered liable:

Tosafot on Makkot 5a:5:1.hebrew: אין העדים נעשים זוממין עד שיזימו עצמן - פי' יזימו עצמן של עדים, שיאמרו להם: אתם במקום פלוני עמנו הייתם; ולא שיזומו שיאמרו: ההורג או הנהרג היה עמנו:
Tosafot on Makkot 5a:5:1.english: "Witnesses are not rendered conspiring until they impeach themselves" - Explanation: [they impeach] the witnesses themselves, that [the second set of witnesses] say to them: "You were with us in such-and-such a place"; and not that they are impeached by [the second witnesses] saying: "The killer or the victim was with us."
